meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将已有小说快速导入标准写作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有写好的小说想继续完善或纳入写作工具链
copy.tagline_en: Import existing novels into a structured writing workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a written novel you want to refine or integrate into a writing toolchain

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先拆解已有小说（半成品或完本）的章节、角色、剧情、设定、文风，再整理成可续写的项目结构（大纲、正文、追踪等），供你继续写下一章。
howto.when: 当你说“/story-import”“导入小说”“反向解析”等指令，或说“把我的书导进来”时触发。

say.note: 会先确认源文件和篇幅，再开始拆解。

say.text: 把我的书导进来，做成能接着写的工程
say.note: 走完整导入流程，生成可续写的项目结构。

say.text: 只拆解分析这本书，不用建工程
say.note: 只生成拆文库，不迁移到项目。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude takes an existing novel (partial or finished), breaks it into chapters, characters, plot, settings, style, routes by length to the long/short pipeline, then builds a writable project (outline, main text, tracking) for continuing the next chapter.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type “/story-import”, say “导入小说” or “反向解析”, or tell Claude “把我的书导进来”（import my book).

say_en.note: It will confirm source and length, then start analyzing.

say_en.text: Import my book and turn it into a project I can keep writing.
say_en.note: Runs the full import and builds a continuable structure.

say_en.text: Just analyze this book, don't build a project.
say_en.note: Only produces the breakdown library, no migration.
